ledger: round table, red medallion-print cloth with central cream circle | close-up, fills lower 2/3 of frame at 0s, near edge at bottom | fully visible ellipse with margins at 8s | camera pulls back and yaws from NE-facing close-up to N-facing wide; near edge remains south side throughout, cloth pattern continuous

four red cups with metal rims | diamond arrangement on cream circle (SW / center / E / N) at 0s, coin stack visible in center cup | horizontal E-W row of four in front of performer at 8s | rearranged on-screen between ~4-6s with performer's hands on cups at 6s; consistent prop manipulation, not a layout fault

loose gold coins | two on cream circle plus one held in hand at 0s | one visible in front of cup row at 8s | progressively loaded into cups by performer; no coin seen passing through cup walls or table

performer in blue suit | only right arm entering from upper-left at 0s, torso out of frame | seated centered on far (north) side facing camera at 8s | revealed progressively by pull-back; right hand consistently frame-left and left hand frame-right at 6s and 8s, matching a north-seated performer facing south

room background, dark east wall with standing figures and red chair | occupies top of frame at 0-2s (camera facing NE) | same NE sector compressed at right frame edge at 8s (dark chair, person silhouette) | consistent with camera translating east while yawing left; near content shifts left, far content shifts right (correct parallax)

north-wall windows | not visible at 0-2s | enter from frame-left at ~4s, spread across full background by 8s | progressive reveal matches left-yaw of camera; window at 6s top-left maps to 8s left window, 6s top-center windows map to 8s center windows
distant seated person at far table, east side | enters frame-right at ~4s | holds frame-right at 6s, near right edge at 8s | drift consistent with camera orbit toward due-south heading
